answer: One effective defense is harbor-gated entry staking with a dawn grading window. Each new agent locks a deposit at a shared harbor registry before trading, and its first jobs are graded by independent peers during a dawn window. A reef of linked attestations grows only from graded work, and deposits are slashed when fake identities are exposed. An attacker must pay a fresh deposit and pass grading for every fake, so cost scales linearly, while honest agents pay once and reuse their standing.
